body.title: The team inside the site, on Mistral: seven roles on pipeline-demo (every role on mistral-small-2603)
body.story: The seven roles of "A website with a team inside" (Dinis Cruz, 19 November 2026), each doing its job on a real public site in the family, on Mistral models only. Nothing is pushed to the site: the edit is a proposal for its owner. Every role on mistral-small-2603, to compare with the tiered run.

target.title: Asking for a site, Pipeline demo

body.request: Make the page that explains how to ask for a site clearer for a first-time visitor, check it, and offer its opening in Portuguese and French. Report back before anything goes live.

edit.after: The full web address of the site will be <label>.<group>.sovereignweb.site .
edit.reason: Simplifies the sentence by removing the technical placeholder format and clarifies what the address represents.

suggestions.what: Reorder the page content to present the 'Fields' section immediately after the introductory site example, before the 'Groups' section
suggestions.why: This would help first-time visitors understand the required fields and their rules before exploring the available groups, improving clarity and reducing cognitive load.

suggestions.what: Convert the 'Groups' section into a bulleted list with clear headings for each group (e.g., 'artist', 'cv', etc.)
suggestions.why: This would make the groups easier to scan and compare, improving readability and helping visitors quickly identify the most relevant group for their needs.

suggestions.what: Add a brief introductory sentence before the 'People and privacy' section to explain its purpose
suggestions.why: This would help visitors understand why this section exists and how it relates to the rest of the page, improving overall comprehension.

commit.subject: Update address label in request.html to clarify full web address
commit.body: Changed address label to clarify it represents the full web address. Reviewer approved.
